Viv proudly hands over a cheque for the money she has raised for the charity, but the police interrupt her speech and arrest her for deception. Gray accuses Katie of snooping.
The police continue to question Viv and fists start to fly between Matthew and Carl. David suggests to Jasmine that they get back together but is humiliated when she turns him down.
Hilary accuses a distraught Viv of using her grandson's memory for profit. Carl assures Donald that he wants nothing to do with Matthew, and Lily and Pearl go speed dating.
Carl looks to hire a PA and Matthew asks Lexi to apply and work as a mole. Hilary's suspicions are aroused when she sees Laurel holding baby Arthur.

Rosemary returns to the village and resolves to move back into Home Farm, resulting in a violent showdown with the King brothers. Also, Perdy is left to babysit the twins; Bob books couples counselling for him and Viv.
Hilary visits the hospital to find out more about Daniel's medical history - and as a result of her enquiries, Ashley and Laurel receive shocking news. Paddy gets a court summons.
Laurel vents her anger on her mother when the doctor reveals it was Hilary who contacted him. Pollard suspects David is the blackmailer and Jasmine and Miles share a kiss.
An investigation into the possible baby swap is launched despite Laurel's insistence that she doesn't want one. Paddy tells Gennie about his court date and Lexi confronts Chas.
Gennie mentions to Paddy that Shadrach reminds her of someone from her youth, before coming face to face with her estranged father. Hilary hears Mel and Greg plan to move away.
Ross admits the truth to Marlon about Shane's behaviour toward Donna, and the pair plot revenge against the shady officer.
Shane delivers a threat to Eli, who proceeds to team up with Marlon to teach him a lesson. Chas is riled by Shadrach's delight at seeing pictures of a youthful Gennie.
A nervous Ross agrees to lure Shane into a trap set by Eli and Marlon. Lexi seeks to impress Carl by drumming up more business, Val tells Diane the Woolpack needs a new look.
Donna is furious when she uncovers Ross and Marlon's scheme to knock Shane down a peg or two. Lexi gains inside information about Carl and Donald's plan to rebrand their company.
TJ is rushed to hospital and diagnosed with an E-coli infection. Matthew fires Jasmine to balance his books and Donna thinks her luck at work has changed when Shane calls a truce.
Environmental Health suggest Jo's cheese may be responsible for the outbreak of E-coli. Gray is visited by Perdy's divorce lawyer and Lily inspires Belle to start her a business.
Gray meets Perdy and is shocked to see where she has been living. Jo and Andy are cleared by Environmental Health after the E-coli outbreak and Eli helps Belle with her business.
Katie is in turmoil when Gray mistakenly calls her Perdy after visiting his wife again. Laurel and Ashley lock horns over what to do about Arthur, and Matthew's car is vandalised.
Hilary runs away with baby Arthur in an attempt to prevent the Dolands leaving, prompting Ashley to drop a bombshell. Zak worries about his job and Gray proposes to Katie.
Pollard wrongly assumes Val is his blackmailer. Mel and Greg are told they need a DNA test at the hospital and Jonny tells Chas and Diane about Katie and Gray's engagement.
Mel and Greg attempt to flee the village with Arthur to avoid the DNA test results. Val is furious when she turns up at the factory and finds Eric mid-discussion with Rosalind.
Hilary decides to leave the village after Laurel tells her she doesn't want baby Arthur in her life. Gennie and her mother bump into a drunken Shadrach.
Gennie explains to Paddy why she snubbed Shadrach. Laurel is horrified to learn the villagers know about the baby swap, and Donna tells Viv there has been no news on Freddie.
Gennie introduces Shadrach to her mother as her biological father. Val bars the Dingles from the Woolpack and Viv creates a wanted poster to help her find Freddie.
Bob worries when Viv starts having nightmares about Freddie. Gennie and her mother visit Shadrach, and Katie is disappointed with the turnout for her engagement party.

Donna and Ross agree to help Viv's search and they go to an empty house belonging to Freddie. Nicola has a disappointingly quiet 30th birthday and her day gets even worse when Paddy lays her off and says Chas is coming back to work. Also, Doug reassures Greg that he has every right to visit Daniel's grave.
Ashley attends the hearing alone and is worried to see his wife with Greg upon his return. Nicola takes an opportunity to help out Paddy, and Viv and Bob are freed on bail.
Viv is devastated when she realises even Bob is questioning her innocence after they are freed on bail. Ashley and Laurel regret going out, and Nicola manipulates Paddy.
Laurel makes a drastic decision after arguing with her dad about Arthur. Shadrach talks to Greg about his experiences with Cain, and Pearl selects a winner for the cruise ticket.
Ashley and Laurel remain at loggerheads as Doug tries to smooth the waters between them. Andy is frustrated with Debbie's presence in Sarah's life and takes his anger out on Jo.
Viv confronts a witness found by her private investigator and Bob begins to doubt his wife. The Dingles steal the pub's furniture as Val prepares for the competition.
Katie is livid when Gray continues to lie to her, so she pays Perdy a visit. Gabby visits Laurel and begs her step-mum to return home and Jo finds a buyer for her goats.
Pollard decides to surprise Val by bringing their wedding forward after he receives a large tax demand. Bob continues to be suspicious of Viv, and Jasmine gets a job at the pub.
Bob gets information about Viv from a witness about a specific date his wife was seen with Freddie. Jimmy confronts Lexi, and Eli damages a delivery for Matthew.
Carl realises he's been double-crossed when he attends Matthew's presentation. Diane is unsure of Pollard's intentions about the wedding, and Zak pulls out all the stops at work.
Zak quits his job when Matthew reveals he will pay Belle's school fees but only after the insurance pays out. Lexi feels guilty about her actions, and Diane rumbles Eric's scheme.
In the 5,000th episode of the soap, Carl realises it was Lexi who double-crossed him. Zak is encouraged by Belle to tell Lisa he has quit, and Pollard chooses his best man.
Lisa struggles to cope at work but is surprised by Pollard's compassion when he gives her some money for lunch. Val's daughter returns, and Jake celebrates his 18th birthday.
Val is kidnapped by the Dingles on her wedding morning after an altercation with Lisa. Also, Marlon is the epitome of stress as he prepares for the judges' arrival.
Laurel still refuses to attend the parental hearing but Ashley gives her a shocking ultimatum. Marlon gets an audition on a TV cookery show, and Andy tells Jo to fire Sam.
Laurel and Ashley are named as Arthur's parents, leaving Mel devastated. Jo is angry with Andy for firing Jake, and Ross becomes jealous when he sees Marlon and Donna together.
Ashley and Laurel take Arthur home while the Dolands are left heartbroken and struggling to cope with their loss. Val agrees to loan David money and Pearl returns from her cruise.
Andy loses his temper when Debbie drops off a present for Sarah at Butler's Farm. Ashley and Doug struggle to comfort Arthur, while Laurel still resists bonding with him.
Jo has a go at Andy for taking his temper out on Sarah's new dolls house. Meanwhile, Greg tells Mel that he's found a buyer for the house and suggests they move to Spain.
Ashley turns to Mel for help with Arthur. Scarlett plans a trip to Canada to spend time with her mum - leaving Lexi feeling alone - and Andy apologises for losing his temper.
Greg is annoyed to discover Mel has visited Arthur. Miles becomes jealous when he sees Jake and Jasmine getting along at the Woolpack, and Nicola spies an opportunity at work.
Jake begins his trial run at the Woolpack, where he and Jasmine start to play pranks on each other. Nicola finds more interest in her services, and Ashley suggests a picnic.
Jasmine ends her relationship with Miles as he continues to be jealous of Jake. Nicola impresses David and Viv is furious when her solicitor tells her to plead guilty.
Nicola enlists David to help with a ferocious Alsatian, but they find themselves locked in the B and B. Louise suggests that she and Jamie buy the shop and cafe.
Marlon enjoys his TV debut, while Donna is left stunned when Ross reveals his feelings for her. David and Nicola go back into business, and Jake tries his luck with a producer.
Donna tells Ross that she loves Marlon but the pair agree to remain friends. Pollard continues to hide his money troubles from Val, and Rodney grows concerned for Gabby.
Pollard admits his money troubles to Val when she cancels the order he was relying on for cash. Gennie tries to live up to her name, and Donna is happy with Marlon's success.
Val tells a shocked Diane she is considering selling her share of the pub to help Eric. Gennie tries to sell Viv a smoothie maker in an attempt to prove her worth as a Dingle.

Eric is forced to break the news to the workers that the factory will have to close - setting off a chain of events that see it go up in smoke. Meanwhile, Jake and Jasmine continue their flirtation, an act that doesn't go unnoticed by Daz.
Carl worries about Donald when he has a funny turn and refuses to go to the hospital. Val accuses Pearl of causing the fire, and the villagers learn about Pollard's plans.
Terry confronts Matthew about the apartment development - warning the businessman he will contest the plans. Marlon is offered a new job, and Carl tells Donald to take it easy.
Marlon and Val argue when the chef learns that they didn't win the Pub of the Year competition. Sam offers to rebuild the factory, and Mel asks Ashley for time with Arthur.
Mel gives Greg an ultimatum when he confronts her about Arthur. Marlon prepares to contact the rival pub about the job offer but Donna urges him to reconsider.
Doug is fearful that Ashley's considering giving Arthur back to the Dolands. Bob and Viv make a decision on guardianship of the twins if they're both sent to jail.
Viv and Bob are stunned by Louise's suggestion she buy their businesses. Gennie worries she'll never be a proper Dingle, and Laurel makes progress with Arthur.
Debbie gets jealous when Eli opts to spend time with Gennie rather than her. Viv tells Louise she'll sell her the business, and Katie informs Gray and Perdy she wants a Caesarean.
Debbie reveals Gennie's scheme to Pollard as jealousy about Eli's friendship with the girl overwhelms her. Lexi asks Donald for her job back and Donna tells Marlon to get a job.
Donald tells Carl about his plans to retire and asks him to be managing director of the company. Diane offers Marlon his old job back and Eli asks Gennie out for lunch.

Eli winds up Debbie about how well he gets on with Gennie and in a fit of temper she tells him she wants him out of the house. A jealous Debbie 'lets slip' to Eric and Val about the factory in the B&B and Eric is furious - until the happy rep puts in another order for 600 curtains.
Donna thinks Ross might become a suspect for the police. Marlon stumbles across the couple. Val doesn't like Daz and Victoria being together.
Marlon tells the police about Shane's blackmailing. Val tells Daz to stay away from Victoria. Lily and Edna try to make up.
When Ross returns to the village and attacks Marlon, he makes a shocking discovery. Jimmy struggles with organizing the funeral.
Matthew is laid to rest, but Jimmy’s fragility breaks when he is told that Tom’s gravestone has been defaced. Meanwhile, Ross pins his hopes on Jasmine.
Jasmine tells Debbie that she intends to confess to the police, while an angry husband on the warpath leads to a trip to hospital.
The Dingles are furious to discover that Donna ’s still living at the house, and Rodney apologises to Jimmy.
Aaron’s far from a forgiving mood and Paul’s upset when he receives a letter from Jonny.
Val tries to cheer Paul up by throwing him a divorce party, and Carl resolves to make a fresh start.
Eli gives Marlon food for thought and Paul pours his heart out to Lily.
A desperate Val takes drastic action to keep Paul in the village, and Aaron continues to make life hard for his mother.
It’s all change at Home Farm as a new family move into the manor, and Aaron leads Belle astray.
Aaron receives the full force of Lisa’s fury when he and Belle steal from the Wyldes’ removal van, and Donna receives a letter calling her as a witness at Ross’ trial.
Donna nervously attends Zak’s birthday party and encounters potentially incriminating evidence, while Natasha is secretly concerned by Mark and Katie’s closeness.
Eli is dragged in for questioning, and Aaron offers to keep Paddy’s crush on Chas a secret.
Eli gets his revenge on Donna by telling a stunned Marlon that she has been visiting Ross, and Mark agrees to let the Kings rent Pear Tree .
Paul and Jonny are reunited, and Marlon makes a devastating admission to Donna.
Jasmine cracks from the pressure and confesses to Laurel that she killed Shane, while Donna makes a big decision.
Zak grills Eli, but as Eli is about to confess, the police arrive and arrest him. Meanwhile, Paul shares his concerns about Rodney to Diane and Nicola.
Eli breaks under police questioning, and Paul discovers the truth.
Debbie founds herself at the mercy of the police, while Donna and Katie have a heart-to-heart.
Ross bids a sad farewell to the village, and the Dingles rally round to keep Debbie’s businesses going.
Donna realises that her marriage is well and truly over when she walks in on Marlon in a compromising position, and Lexi takes matters into her own hands.

Carl puts pressure on Chas for his money but she threatens to tell Lexi about their kiss and Carl agrees to wait until Debbie's release. Lexi is unsettled and feels even more insecure when Lisa says that she'll always be a second rate Chas in Carl's eyes.

Paddy is gutted when Marlon confesses that he slept with Chas and he storms back to the vet's, only to find Aaron selling drugs to a mate. Paddy tells Chas about Aaron but her mind is elsewhere after hearing that Carl and Lexi are engaged.

Gennie and Leyla are in Brenda’s bad books following the aromatherapy fiasco. When it transpires that Leyla has spent the money Gennie paid her for the treatment, Gennie angrily states that they’re no longer friends. Bob tries to cheer Brenda up by setting up a webcam so she can talk to Terry. After Brenda speaks to Terry, TJ steps in front of the webcam.

Victoria is furious to learn of Andy’s decision to sell the farm. When Andy snaps and tells Victoria that if Jack cared about the farm, he’d be with them, she storms out. Daz tries to comfort Victoria but it’s obvious she's missing Jack.

Diane tries to stay strong for the kids and arranges to go to Spain to collect Jack's body. Val worries about Diane and asks Katie to convince a grieving Andy to help with the funeral arrangements. Katie has a word with Andy but he angrily tells her to leave.

Diane returns to the village with Annie for Jack's funeral. Victoria seeks reassurances from Annie that Jack hadn't forgotten about her and gets some peace of mind when Annie begins reminiscing. Alan agrees to help organise the service. Annie is alarmed to hear that Andy is having doubts about whether to attend, but Daz says he'll make sure that he's there.

Victoria prepares herself for Jack's funeral and tells an upset Daz that she's planning to move to Spain with Annie. Daz begs Victoria to change her mind and almost admits his feelings for her, but stops himself just in time as the hearse arrives to take them to the funeral. Meanwhile, Robert is watching from a distance.

Debbie is glum when her solicitor advises her to plead guilty and opt for a charge of manslaughter rather than running the gauntlet of a murder trial. Back in the village, Zak is furious to see what he assumes is a reporter snooping around Tug Ghyll.

The Dingles are alarmed to hear that Cain was arrested at the port. Sure it is Andy’s doing, Zak and Shadrach head to Butler's but Andy insists he’ll do whatever it takes to protect Sarah. Zak slams him against a wall and Shadrach goads him for being afraid of Cain.
Eli tells the police he wants to change his statement to say that he saw Jasmine murder Shane and continues to drop the bombshell that Jasmine and Debbie were lovers.

Diane returns to the village with Annie for Jack's funeral. Victoria seeks reassurances from Annie that Jack hadn't forgotten about her and gets some peace of mind when Annie begins reminiscing. Alan agrees to help organise the service. Annie is alarmed to hear that Andy is having doubts about whether to attend, but Daz says he'll make sure that he's there.

Victoria prepares herself for Jack's funeral and tells an upset Daz that she's planning to move to Spain with Annie. Daz begs Victoria to change her mind and almost admits his feelings for her, but stops himself just in time as the hearse arrives to take them to the funeral. Meanwhile, Robert is watching from a distance.

Victoria prepares herself for Jack's funeral and tells an upset Daz that she's planning to move to Spain with Annie. Daz begs Victoria to change her mind and almost admits his feelings for her, but stops himself just in time as the hearse arrives to take them to the funeral. Meanwhile, Robert is watching from a distance.

Mark is unnerved when Natasha reveals that Tristan is on his way to sort things out. Tristan arrives with no idea that his wife has left him. Tristan deludes himself into thinking Maisie is just being dramatic but her reaction suggests otherwise when she enters and fumes with her mother's obvious interference.

Victoria is annoyed to hear of Andy’s cattle purchase before the will reading has taken place. In his will, Jack leaves Robert, Andy, Daz and Victoria an equal share to be paid in annual instalments. Andy is angry that he can’t have the full amount and fumes that Diane has been left 50% share of the remaining estate.

Marlon receives a visiting order from Debbie and decides to use the opportunity to convince her to see Eli. When he arrives Debbie won't budge and tells him that she doesn't want to see Eli. Marlon refuses to give in and starts to make progress when Debbie reacts to the news that Eli tried to turn himself in to save her.
Ryan can't stop thinking about Maisie and jumps at the chance of going Home Farm with Katie.

Eric is avoiding Val and she is avoiding him. Amy tells David about Michael's accusations. David tries to speak to Eric but he walks away. Adam breaks up with Scarlett, she is devastated. Will is playing games with Belle, he keeps getting calls on his mobile and eventually throws it on the floor, breaking it. He confides in Belle that Nathan keeps calling him.

Chas and Cameron are enjoying their time in a hotel room, but Cameron suggests they should venture out as a real couple in public. At the same time, Cain receives a phone call from Cameron's son asking for his dad, and Cain realises that Cameron is not in Jersey.

In the hotel room, Chas worries that Cain knows about her affair, but Cameron attempts to reassure her that he will sort it. The pair soon return to the Emmerdale, and Cain quizzes Cameron about his weekend in Jersey.

David urges Jacob to tell Alicia that he doesn't like Talia, but the youngster refuses. David shares this information with Alicia himself, advising her to calmly explain this to Justin and make him realise that Jacob wants to stay in Emmerdale.

David discusses the fake marriage idea with Alicia, but she wishes he knew how she felt about him. Eric is exasperated when he hears of their plans, warning David that he will be left with nothing if he marries Alicia.

Alicia insists to David that they should tell Jacob the truth about their wedding, but David disagrees. Amy questions the pair about their marriage plans and is sceptical of their answers, but decides to be happy for them.

Chas feels guilty as Debbie explains how happy she is with Cameron and how they have both agreed it feels like they have fallen in love all over again. Soon afterwards, Chas questions Cameron about how good his relationship with Debbie is, and she is furious when he tells her that he can't just switch off the feelings he has for Debbie.

Gennie reels as Chas and Cameron try to explain themselves. The cheating pair then panic when Gennie says that Debbie is on her way over. Mid-conversation, Debbie arrives and they all cover. Chas and Cameron then make a quick exit, frantically trying to pull themselves together.

Chas visits Cameron at the garage and suggests they should go somewhere to talk. However, Debbie suddenly arrives with Sarah, forcing Chas to cover. Later in The Woolpack, Chas is shaken when Gennie storms in, furious that Chas has told Charity about her being pregnant.

Cameron snaps at Debbie when she tells him that there is something wrong with Gennie, advising her to stay out of it. Later, Cameron thanks Gennie for not telling Debbie about the affair, promising it is now over. However, Gennie is angered by his words, declaring that she has done it for Debbie and Chas, not for him.

Charity is shocked that Nikhil hasn't been to see Gennie after she informed him of the pregnancy. She pushes him to sort things out with her. At the same time, Gennie tells Chas that Nikhil has decided they should take a break, and she worries about how she will cope with being a single parent.
Rishi has spent the night on the sofa in the back room of The Woolpack and offers support to Val over Amy, who is celebrating her 18th birthday today.

Jai is still behaving coldly towards Charity following the recent problems between them. Soon afterwards, Georgia arrives unannounced and Charity quickly tells her that Gennie is pregnant, hoping that Georgia won't say why she has turned up.

Jai and Charity remain on bad terms following yesterday's row. In the factory, everyone gathers to look at Gennie's scan picture and Rishi insists they should go for a team drink. In The Woolpack, Charity arrives and attempts to speak to Jai, but he leaves her brooding.

At the factory, Rachel unsuccessfully attempts to leave without waking Jai. Both are mortified over what they have done. In denial, Jai warns Rachel that it never happened. Back at home, Charity is angry that Jai didn't come home last night and storms out when he turns up, not wanting to hear his excuses.

Ashley has spent the night at the cricket pavilion and feels more desperate then ever as he swipes a sandwich from David's shop. Later, outside the church, Ashley spots Laurel with Gabby heading for the school trip.

Rodney and Edna are worried after having no luck finding Ashley. When Rodney continues the search, he eventually finds the ex-vicar rummaging in a bin. Rodney is horrified at what his friend has become.

Cain notices that Gennie is furious with Cameron. When Cain asks her for an explanation, Gennie covers by saying that she just doesn't like him - but Cain is not convinced. Later, Cameron is making the final preparations to flee the village today, but Cain can sense that he is up to something.

Cain calls an ambulance while Cameron tells Debbie not to move. The two men silently fume at each other. As Debbie is rushed to hospital, Chas is impatient waiting for Cameron to turn up. When she arrives at Tug Ghyll, a frantic Andy tells her what has happened to Debbie.
After the scan, Debbie is still worried despite being told that the baby is fine. At the same time, Chas is in pieces, guilty as she insists to Cain that Cameron loves Debbie.

After rounding people up to look for Ashley, Marlon puts his feelings for Laurel aside and reassures her they will find him. In Hotten, Ashley sees the homeless pair who stole his phone. He begs desperately for them to give it back, but they refuse and mock him. Suddenly, Marlon appears and steps in to defend Ashley.

Alicia attempts to explain her feelings to David, but is gutted when he tells her that he has never thought about her in that way. Later, as Alicia prepares for her appearance in court, the pressure is too much for them both.

Lisa is worried after receiving a phone call from Zak, who tells her that he is coming home. As Zak is reunited with his family, he is desperate to show Lisa and Sam that he is on the mend. He passes Lisa his medication, saying she should look after it.

Zak is alarmed after reading a hand delivered letter. When Lisa and Sam leave for work, he grabs a shovel and heads out with his van keys. He arrives at the moorland and begins to dig, telling walkers that he is looking for something he buried.

Zak heads off in his van, unaware that Belle has hidden herself inside after sensing that something is wrong with her father. Zak then pulls into a barn, where he has arranged to meet the loan sharks. The men lose their patience as Zak tells them that he doesn't have any money after all and they should do their worst on him, offering himself up as a sacrifice.

Charity calls Cain as she drives off with Lisa. She pleads with Cain to help find and save Zak, but Cain cancels the call and turns off his phone. Soon afterwards, Charity surprises the loan sharks as she suddenly appears, skidding the car to a halt outside the barn. She threatens the men that she will tell the police they have hurt Belle.

Lisa tells Lizzie that she doesn't know if she can forgive Zak for putting Belle in such danger. She adds that he isn't her Zak anymore and that he should have stayed in hospital. When Lizzie asks if she still loves Zak, it's clear that Lisa is unsure.

Paddy is in turmoil as he works himself up to make the phone call to accept the job in New Zealand. After Paddy does so, he and Rhona are excited, but are quickly brought back to reality with the thought of breaking the news to Marlon.

Paddy is all set on leaving for New Zealand regardless of Marlon's complaints. However, Pearl is upset to hear of Paddy and Rhona's plans and makes things awkward by asking Marlon why he hasn't stopped them.
Amy and Victoria head into Hotten for Amy's belated birthday celebrations. Victoria is fed up with Alex, while Amy is determined that they are going to have a great night out.

Val is suspicious over Amy's swollen lip. Guessing there is more to it, Val reminds Amy that she is there for her. Soon afterwards, Val tricks Victoria into revealing everything about the confrontation at the pub. Later, Val confronts Amy, explaining that she and Eric will support her whatever happens.
Val barges over to see Eric, who is aghast as Val relays the news about Kerry. Both worry about whether they should tell Amy that her mum tried to visit.

Marlon is confused and angry that Laurel has not said this before. Marlon explains that he can't cope with the heartache again, or to be her plan B just because it has gone wrong with Ashley. Soon afterwards, Marlon opens up to Chas about what has just happened.

Marlon is still confused over whether to stay behind with Laurel or leave for New Zealand with his son Leo. Laurel heads to see Marlon, reminding him that she wants them to be a proper couple and a family. Later, Marlon sees Leo and as he holds his son in his arms, he is aware of the enormity of the decision.

Debbie is confused when Cameron suggests they should go out for lunch. Later, when Cameron realises that Debbie is too busy to take a lunch break, he seizes the moment and gets down on one knee at the garage to propose. However, Debbie feels awkward over the sudden proposal and asks for time to think.

A flustered Rachel has made the decision that she wants a termination. Ali offers to accompany her to the doctors, but Rachel wants to go alone. Later, Jai is forced to step in when Charity tears a strip off Rachel for being late to work. Rachel gives as good as she gets to Charity and storms out of the factory.

Rachel struggles to keep it together as she tries to convince herself that a termination is the right decision. At the same time, Nikhil and Gennie's baby talk proves too much for Jai, who snaps at them. Soon afterwards, Jai secretly gives Rachel the money for the termination, while Nikhil eventually apologises to his brother for going on about his baby.

It's the day of Rachel's termination and she is on edge. Ali points out that she doesn't have to go through with it, but Rachel is determined it's what she has to do. At the same time, Charity is preparing for the family barbecue at Holdgate Farm, but a distracted Jai returns empty-handed without the meat he was supposed to buy.

Rachel reminds Jai that once they keep the baby, there would be no going back. Rachel is torn as Jai leaves her to face the biggest decision of her life. Later, Ali finds Rachel in tears, admitting that she hasn't gone through with the termination. At the same time, Charity is on the warpath over Jai's attitude after he vanished from their planned barbecue day.

Rishi advises Jai to sort things with Charity before it's too late, but he is not entirely reassured by his son. At the factory, Rachel tells Jai that she is not going back on her word and they agree to meet to talk. Later, safely outside the perimeter of the village, Jai and Rachel meet to talk through the options.

Jimmy and Carl argue about the business, unhappy to have lost an important contract with Gorwell's when Robbie missed a crucial delivery. They have also been turned down by Nikhil after offering to take on the Sharma driving work. After resolving to do something about it, Jimmy bluffs as he hints to Charity about the business, attempting to get her to reconsider.

Moira prepares for a meeting with Jeff, a potential new client. Alex is increasingly attracted to Moira, saying that she will knock Jeff dead. He then starts to feel jealous as Jeff enjoys Moira's company. Jeff is impressed but is not sure the farm has the required capacity, but Alex stands up for Moira by making an impassioned plea for him to take the business seriously.

Amy is unimpressed when Brenda tries to give her advice on Kerry, as she is determined to put her mum behind her. Soon afterwards, Brenda answers the phone in the B&B to one of Kerry's friends, telling Amy that it sounded serious.

Amy is confused about what Val wants her to do about Kerry and Brenda realises that she can't win as she tries to help. Amy is torn when David tries to make her see that this could be her last chance to make things up with Kerry. At the same time, Brenda is hurt as Val and Eric continue to grow closer over the situation with Amy.

Kerry tries to explain herself to Amy. At the same time, Eric reassures Val that Amy will still want her even if she makes it up with Kerry. He is surprised but grateful when Val apologises about everything and says that she hopes Eric might have made a mistake by getting with Brenda. Amy is conflicted as Kerry says that she wants to make things right.

An uneasy Amy begins to spend some time with Kerry. When Kerry wants to go to the pub, Amy agrees. Inside The Woolpack, a torn Amy defends herself to Victoria, explaining that Kerry is her mum and she doesn't know when or if she'll see her again. Kerry is awkward when Amy questions her drinking, swiftly ordering a cola instead.

Paddy is convinced Marlon has a surprise planned for his stag do, but is guilty when Marlon puts him straight. He hasn't given it much thought, as he is spending as much time as possible with his son. Marlon explains Paddy and Rhona's stag and hen party are in the same place at the same time. Paddy makes light of this, but Marlon is too upset to joke with him.

Rachel is furious with Jai realising he hasn't told Charity the situation. He apologises, but explains he cannot lose Charity. Later, Rachel is gobsmacked when Jai tells her he will pay for her to live in a posh flat in Leeds. Rachel is adamant she is proud of her baby and will not be hidden away, but Jai insists he just wants what is best for his child and doesn't want Rachel struggling to pay…

Charity explains to Carl and Jimmy that she and Rishi have won the Strikes contract the Kings so desperately needed. Jimmy makes the point that they don't have any haulage but Charity is quick to shoot him down, explaining that Rishi has the funds to combat that issue. Jimmy quickly realises Charity is serious and looks to Carl for help.

Paddy spends the night at the Dingles. He is down about Marlon not being his best man, but agrees when Chas offers to take it on. Marlon receives news from his solicitor that he can stop Paddy and Rhona from taking Leo to New Zealand. He contemplates his next move and Laurel urges him to go to the wedding.

As Paddy and Rhona take their vows, Paddy interrupts, insisting Marlon should be up there with them. Paddy and Rhona are pronounced husband and wife and Paddy cannot thank Marlon enough for being there. However, Rhona wants the day to be about them and not Marlon.

Moira enjoys the attention from Alex as she announces they have got the restaurant contract. Later, Alex and Moira laugh as she teases him. Alex is embarrassed when Andy arrives and announces Alex has finished things with Victoria.

Alex is awkward around Moira, although Andy assumes he is just avoiding work. Moira then steps in to defend Alex when Andy complains about his apparent lack of motivation. Later, Moira returns home from the pub to a highly charged atmosphere between herself and Alex.

Paddy is still furious over Marlon, refusing to let him mess up their lives. However, Rhona thinks they should get confirmation first that Marlon and Laurel really are together. Rhona urges Paddy to follow Marlon outside, and Paddy is suspicious when he sees an exchange between Marlon and Laurel.

Dan arrives home and admits to Bob that he spent the night with Chas. He is concerned that he has lost a friend, as he automatically assumes she will not be speaking to him again. At the same time, Priya realises who Chas spent the night with and taunts her. Chas's attention is elsewhere as she watches Cameron kiss Debbie.

Eric visits Brenda and apologises for making her feel left out. Later at the B&B, Kerry asks to borrow money from Amy, reminding her of a day at the fair they once had. Amy remembers Kerry took money from her piggy bank to pay for it. Soon afterwards, thinking the coast is clear as she does some cleaning, Kerry spots some petty cash and pockets a wad of notes - unaware that Val has seen…
Eric pulls away from the kiss with Val. Mortified, he tells her to leave. Having witnessed the whole thing, Brenda is devastated and hurries away unseen.
There is a frosty atmosphere between Zak and Lisa as she tells him that she went up to check on him at Home Farm last night and overheard him talking openly to Megan.

Charity demands that Jai should cancel his plans and watch Noah in the show at the village hall. Realising he has no choice, Jai attempts to warn Rachel, but is unsuccessful as Charity swipes his phone. Later in The Woolpack, Jai is awkward as Ali questions Rachel about being stood up, while Dan wonders why Rachel is only drinking water.

Ali is worried about Rachel, aware that everyone knows about her pregnancy. She takes Rachel's phone, determined to discover who the father is, but Rachel catches her and storms out. Soon afterwards, David is sympathetic towards Rachel at the café. This leaves Ali convinced that David is the father, so she later rages at him in The Woolpack in front of everyone.

Megan is unimpressed when Declan explains that Katie will accompany her to the meeting while he is in London. When Megan shares this news with Robbie, the schemer deliberately opens a gate to the field where Katie's horses are kept. Just before the meeting, Katie receives a call and has to leave in order to attend to the loose horses.

As the village's fun run begins, Chas is suddenly very aware that Cameron, Carl and Dan are all competing for her attention. Dan struggles as he completes his first lap, while Nikhil and David begin their third. Carl, meanwhile, is livid when Sean trips him up - encouraging his dad to leg it.

Chas is furious after hearing Cameron's revelation and lays into him over what he's put her through. Cameron is adamant that he loves Chas and wants to be with her, but Chas is strong - demanding that he should return to Debbie. When Cameron insists that Chas shouldn't be with Dan, she loses patience and knees him in the crotch.

Chas is confused about Dan turning her proposal down and offloads to Priya. At the same time, Dan despairs as Nikhil, Gennie and Bob discover that Chas proposed to him. He explains that he cannot marry someone just because they like him. Soon afterwards, Bob tells Chas that she needs to make up her mind as to whether she loves Dan or not.

Priya flirts with David and suggests they should meet in secret. Soon afterwards, David asks Rachel to look after Jacob, making the excuse that he's going for a run. He then meets Priya outside the village and they kiss passionately.

Laurel assures Marlon that she will tell Ashley about their relationship. At the same time, an oblivious Ashley explains to Diane that he could be moving back into Mulberry Cottage soon as things are going so well with Laurel.

It's the day of the court case. Laurel realises that she cannot let Marlon go through this alone, so she lies to both Sandy and work before turning up at court. Rhona is furious to see where Laurel's loyalty lies and soon snaps at her, blaming Laurel for the situation.

Paddy and Rhona are miserable after the court case, and Rhona storms out when Paddy says that she shouldn't have made a scene in court. Soon afterwards, Marlon calls round to collect Leo, but they both refuse - saying that it's inconvenient. Marlon leaves and is even more hardened towards the couple.
A devastated Ashley heads out of The Woolpack after hearing the news about Marlon and Laurel. He finally realises what Laurel had been trying to tell him in the pub.

Diane encourages Ashley to do some shifts in the pub, but Marlon is thrown to find Ashley there when he turns up for work. Later, Ashley goes to Mulberry Cottage to explain the situation to his children. Laurel tries to avoid it, but Ashley is determined, controlled and reasonable as he explains to the kids that Marlon is their mummy's new boyfriend.

Amy is upset that Kerry didn't come after her and instead remained flirting with Andy in The Woolpack. Soon afterwards, Amy is seething when Kerry admits that she stole money from Eric. Kerry explains her reasons and says that she has been grafting at the B&B to pay it off.

Despite still being irked by Robbie, Katie is amused when he flaunts Cheryl - a 'Katie lookalike girl' - around Home Farm, knowing that he is trying to wind her up. Katie is deliberately extra nice to her

Declan picks up on the tension between Katie and Robbie. However, Robbie feigns innocence, pretending that he is worried about how he may have offended Katie when he gave her a quick peck on the cheek recently. Katie is unimpressed when Declan suggests that she may have got it wrong about Robbie coming onto her.

Declan feels bad as he leaves Katie alone with Robbie and heads off for a meeting. When Robbie makes reference to the fact that it will be just the two of them, Katie makes him aware that she will be at the stables all morning. Intrigued as to why she has told him, Robbie makes his way to the stables and offers Katie a hand.

Declan is furious after watching the CCTV footage from the stables, and immediately starts stuffing Robbie's belongings into bags. Robbie attempts to defend himself and when Megan arrives, Katie suggests that she should take a look at the footage and decide for herself. Megan is surprised by her instinctive feelings towards Robbie when Declan says he has to leave.

Katie is furious with Declan for not throwing Robbie out. Megan later tells Robbie that he must apologise to Declan. Realising he has no other option, Robbie apologises, promising to stay out of his and Katie's way in future.

Cameron tells Chas that Carl is convinced she is marrying Dan as a cover for something. When Cameron quizzes Chas over whether she really loves Dan, she gets upset and Cameron recognises it. The former lovers long to touch one another, but know they can't.

Chas is suspicious as Dan and Diane encourage her to go out for the day. The Dingles get the house ready, and Chas is gobsmacked but pleased when she discovers that they have thrown a surprise party to celebrate her engagement. At the gathering, Gennie worries that Chas is marrying Dan on the rebound, but Chas is adamant that she has moved on.
Carl is smug after witnessing Cameron and Chas kissing. Charity misreads his attitude, presuming that Carl is still hung up on Chas. She advises him to move on as Chas now loves Dan.

At the pub, Carl tells Jimmy to take Nicola to York for a romantic break, before asking Chas if she has ever been there - knowing that she went with Cameron. Chas is rattled, but Carl enjoys the game and shows her that he has her mobile.
Carl pretends to forward a photo of Chas and Cameron to Debbie, warning Chas that he would just like his £30,000 back after she took it from him.

The taxi has arrived to collect Paddy and Rhona, and they're both sad yet excited about leaving for New Zealand. Laurel tries to reassure Marlon that the police are on their way, but he cannot wait any longer and catches Paddy and Rhona just as they are saying their goodbyes to Pearl.

A distraught Marlon arrives home, having spent the night in the police station. Devastated and clueless over what he is going to do next, Marlon explains to Laurel that he has no idea when he will next see Leo, furious that Rhona has taken him. At the same time, Paddy arrives home to see the locum Matt arriving.

At the factory, a subdued Gennie tells Laurel about her check-up that morning. However, she is soon unsettled by Laurel talking about the birth. When Gennie leaves, Nikhil worries to Laurel over how scared Gennie is.

Rachel is still bored and lonely at the flat, and ends up scaring the cleaner with her over-familiarity. She later meets Ali in the café for a coffee and gets upset. Jai spots this and signals for her to call him. They meet at the factory, where Rachel tells Jai that she doesn't want to stay in the flat.

Debbie finds the insulin pen in Sarah's bag and storms round to Andy's. At the same time, Kerry tells Val and Eric that she's staying on in the village, but is devastated by some home truths from Val. Kerry then feels her world is falling apart when Andy tells her to leave. Kerry asks Eric if she can stay for just one more night. When he refuses, Kerry despairs.

As she and Eric wait for news on Kerry, Val fears it's all her fault. At the same time, all talk in the pub is about Kerry. Andy is stunned and saddened when Victoria gives him the news, while Val tells Eric that she is going to make things right if Kerry pulls through. Soon afterwards, Eric suggests that they should make a go of things again as a couple, and he and Val finally kiss.

Amy returns to see her mother. On arriving at the hospital, she is full of bravado, but suddenly gets emotional when David and Eric explain that it's not looking good for Kerry. At Kerry's bedside, Eric and David fill Amy in on her mum's recent behaviour. Amy is angry at Kerry for trying to kill herself, but she is concerned when Kerry goes into a seizure.

Amy tells Val that she would like to see Kerry in hospital, as she has things she wants to say to her. However, when Amy arrives, she is worried to hear that Kerry has discharged herself. At the same time, Kerry arrives back in the village looking unwell. Victoria persuades her to come back to the house and offers to help her pack, but secretly Victoria starts to form a plan.

With Laurel in financial difficulty, Marlon suggests that she could move in with him. However, she turns the offer down, leaving him feeling disappointed. Finding a new way to help, Marlon realises that he could instead pay Laurel's rent for this month. Laurel feels guilty when Lizzie informs her that Marlon has suggested this, so she tells Marlon that she will move in with him after all.

Cameron is stressed and distracted as he leaves a voicemail for Chas, while Sarah is feeling poorly. Pushed to the end of his tether when he gets another text from Carl, Cameron is tempted to pocket cash from a customer, but he feels guilty as Zak interrupts him, so he puts the cash in the box.

At the hospital, there is a tense atmosphere as Debbie panics about Sarah, while still snapping at Cameron for leaving her unattended. Charity explains that Debbie is just scared, but Cameron leaves for the garage, thinking she's better off without him at the moment. Debbie feels guilty when Charity reminds her that Cameron has stuck by them both.

Cameron and Andy try to reason with Debbie when she is insistent that she wants to be induced immediately. Charity sees that she is desperate and goes to get the doctor. Debbie then begs the doctor to induce her, but he refuses.

Cameron feigns concern at the garage when he tells Zak that the car has gone, and Zak feels bad believing that he might have left the keys in it. Soon afterwards, Cameron storms in to see Carl, telling him that he will get his half of the money - but the rest will be down to Chas.

Laurel receives a call from Gabby's teacher to explain that the youngster is sick. To ease relations at home, Marlon has bought Sandy a surprise mobility scooter, but Sandy is unimpressed. Home from school, Gabby causes problems for Laurel and Marlon and is then upset to see the couple kissing.

Laurel keeps Gabby off school, afraid that she will tell the teacher Marlon hit her. Laurel is determined to sort things out with Ashley and explains what has happened, telling him they need to put a stop to it quickly. A guilty Ashley goes to see Gabby and asks her if she lied about Marlon hitting her so she could live with him instead.

Rishi is puzzled to hear that he had apparently called Jai about Nikhil and Gennie going to hospital. Soon afterwards, Jai visits Rachel to apologise and explain what happened. She allows him to keep the scan picture. Later, Rishi is holding the fort at the factory when he finds the scan photo - with the name 'Breckle' typed on it - stuffed in Jai's desk drawer.

Carl again suggests that Chas should use the pub takings to pay him off, ordering her to have the money by tomorrow. Deeply shaken, Chas visits Cameron to tell him about Carl's threat and his suggestion of robbing the pub. They're both at a loss over what they should do, but Chas eventually tells Cameron to steal the money as she can't take it from Diane herself.

Cameron breaks into the pub, checking no-one has heard anything. The next morning, Ashley and Gabby come downstairs to find the pub has been burgled. Chas tells a tearful Diane that she didn't lock the money away, believing that Cameron took it as planned.

Chas warns Cameron that Carl is not going to let the matter drop, despite now having his money. At the same time, Carl is furious to learn that Jimmy has bought Cameron's van, realising his blackmail money is actually Jimmy's. Back at the garage, Cameron squares up to Carl as he winds him up, but when Carl leaves, he takes out his mobile to make a call.

Chas tries to act normal when Diane asks if she thinks Cameron burgled The Woolpack. She denies it could have been him, but Diane is still not convinced. At the same time, Cain is on a mission to prove that Cameron is lying, as he is not satisfied with Debbie's answers over where Cameron was on the night of the burglary.

Cain wants to know what's going on with Chas and why she needed the money, but she is adamant that she doesn't need his help. Cain then tells Debbie it was Chas who robbed the pub, and apologises to Cameron. Debbie is concerned and wants answers from Chas.

Jimmy voices his worries to Nicola about Carl and Charity being suspiciously nice to each other, knowing something is amiss. Jimmy then interrupts Carl as he winds up Cameron, taking him aside for a chat. Jimmy is shocked to learn that it is Chas who is getting under Carl's skin.

Jimmy is at the end of his tether with his brother, and is worried about the situation with Carl and Chas. Later, Jimmy is thrown when he sees a 'For Sale' sign being put up outside his own house. He questions Carl, reminding him that family is all they have left, but he is shaken by Carl's harsh words

Jimmy tries to come to terms with what is happening as a cold Carl tells him that he needs to stand on his own two feet. Nicola is crestfallen when Jimmy tells her that Carl is kicking them out, but Rodney says they're welcome to stay with him as long as they need. At Mill Cottage, Jimmy is shocked to find Carl has packed his things, unable to comprehend the depth of his betrayal.

Charity feigns reluctance when Jimmy comes to her wanting to sell his share of the business but shakes his hand, barely able to conceal her delight. At the same time, Chas is intrigued to discover that Carl has thrown Nicola and Jimmy out, wondering what he is going to do next.

It's Chas and Dan's wedding day, and Chas is desperately trying to keep her nerves in check. As Debbie nervously awaits her induction this afternoon, Cameron steals an opportunity to see Chas by offering to deliver the flowers Debbie has bought her.

At Tug Ghyll, Debbie starts experiencing contractions and tries to get hold of Cameron, who is about to confront Carl. Unable to reach Cameron, Debbie tells Cain and Zak that they need to get her to the hospital ASAP.

As Chas and Dan sign the register, Carl arrives at the church. Carl is livid that Chas has fooled him and follows as the congregation leave the church. He then confronts Chas but is distracted when he receives a call from Cameron.

Cameron tries to come to terms with what he has done. He puts his clothes in the wash and scrubs himself, trying to get rid of any trace of Carl. Adam and Victoria walk back from Declan and Katie's wedding, they stop by the garage for a kiss, unaware of Carl's body lying close to them.

Jimmy still feels responsible for Carl's death. Debbie wakes up, anxious about the cord test. She tells Cameron she needs a charger for her phone, Cameron says he will call Cain but forgets. Declan, Katie, Megan and Robbie all argue over breakfast at Home Farm, but are interrupted by Nicola who breaks the news to Megan that Carl is dead.

A livid Debbie shows Cameron the texts she's received. As Jimmy is escorted into a police car, Nicola tells him to not say anything until his solicitor is there. Andy interrupts Cameron and Debbie mid-row, she asks him to take the kids. Jimmy sits in a police cell, struggling to come to terms with what he thinks he's done. Diane gives Chas the news that Jimmy has been arrested.

Cameron tries again to persuade Chas to run away, but despite her guilt and confusion she refuses, determined to face her fate. At the same time, Cain is ready for a fight. Debbie has had enough and storms over to the pub to have it out with Chas. She is followed by the rest of the family and all of them mean business.

Chas prepares to answer questions from her solicitor, pleading that she didn't mean to kill Carl. She explains to DI Drake that Carl was blackmailing her, but digs herself in deeper as she tries to prove that she acted in self-defence.

Dan has been at the station all night, wanting to see Chas. Chas is taken from her cell and questioned again. The police produce an evidence bag with her wedding band, which had been found lying next to Carl's body. At the same time, Cameron's panic rises as he is questioned by the police over his affair with Chas.

Cameron is stunned that Chas has been charged with murder. Over at the hospital, Debbie and Andy are concerned for Sarah, wondering how she is going to handle the news about Chas and Cameron. Debbie makes it clear that she doesn't want Cameron to visit Sarah. In the end, the Dingle family decide to cut Chas off for what she has done.

Cain takes Cameron to Tug Ghyll, and Cameron tries to cover his unease as Debbie prepares to tell him the rules of visiting Sarah. At the hospital, Cameron steels himself to go and see Sarah and Debbie follows, hoping she is doing the right thing by letting him in. Sarah is sad as Cameron explains that he and Debbie have decided not to live together anymore and prepares himself to say goodbye.

At the hospital, Sarah is anxious about losing her hair, while Debbie is determined that Cameron will be gone after today. Over at the B&B, Cameron packs his things as Val tells him that a bigger man would have stood by Chas. Leaving the house with Jack, Debbie sees Cameron and tells him to help himself to his things and never come back.

Cameron visits Chas, adamant that he will get a lawyer with the rest of the cash, which leaves her feeling grateful. Debbie is wounded when Cameron tells her that he's decided to stick around for Chas. Debbie is hard-faced, but crumbles when he leaves.

Cameron informs Chas that he has got her a lawyer, and she is close to despair over the guilt of what she did. He also tells her about the damaged truck and Chas worries about what Cain will do to Cameron, but she has an idea. Later, Cameron returns the cash that Chas took from Diane, but breaks the news that while Chas is inside she wants him to have her share of The Woolpack's income, and Diane…

Scarlett arrives back in the village and heads to the office. She finds Charity working there and is curious when Rodney tells her that there have been a few changes. At the same time, Megan finds Jimmy in the graveyard. She tries to comfort him, but is shocked when he snaps at her.

Nicola and Scarlett worry about Jimmy as he reads the condolence cards. Jimmy is adamant that Thomas and Anya must not find out the truth about Tom's death. Nicola and Scarlett then give him the eulogy they've written for him to help him out.

Jimmy returns to the funeral after looking for Thomas, unable to find him. Edna is adamant that she'll go and look for him, while Jude urges them to continue the funeral. Edna finds Thomas and tries to talk to him, but realises it's going to be harder than she imagined. Jimmy decides to go ahead with the burial even though

Jimmy prepares to go into the office and take on Charity, leaving Nicola hopeful. However, Charity tells him that she has different priorities to the rest of the family, and knows she has him exactly where she wants him. Back at Mill Cottage, Jimmy braces himself to tell Nicola that he wants out of the business.

Jimmy closes down an argument between Thomas, Anya and Scarlett regarding Carl's shares. Scarlett tells Adam and Victoria that she's staying in the village for the foreseeable future, while Nicola hardens as Jimmy says that he has made his decision about the business.

Megan assures Robbie that she knows what she is doing with her plans for Declan. When Declan and Katie return from their honeymoon, they are shocked to see that Megan is still around and has been living at Mulberry Cottage. Katie reels when Megan explains that Chas has been banged up for murdering Carl, and Declan apologises to Katie for keeping this news a secret.

At Home Farm, Declan instructs Nicola to get his solicitor and call the private investigator, determined to know why Megan is lying. He later tells Katie that he is meeting the solicitor. Later, the pressure mounts on Megan as she looks over the paperwork, and Robbie is impatient about staying on in the village

Robbie turns up at Mulberry Cottage after spending the night away, and Megan breaks the news that Declan wants them out. Katie takes a cheque round to Megan from Declan, leaving Megan feeling drained. Katie tells Declan that Megan and Robbie are leaving and there is nothing to stand in their way anymore.

Declan is puzzled as Megan asks Katie about setting Robbie up with the CCTV, saying that Gennie has busted her. Katie denies setting him up and Declan tells them to leave, but Katie knows she's in hot water when Declan demands the truth. He is astonished to learn what really happened and Katie's heart sinks as she realises the depth of his anger. Back at Mulberry Cottage,

Paddy feels like a complete failure over his canoe 'adventure'. When Marlon teases him, the pair bicker. Marlon is delighted to learn that Sean filmed Paddy in the canoe, and he goes into the café as Rachel shows him the footage. Soon afterwards in the village, Marlon's dog Daisy comes off her lead and is hit by Ashley's car.

Kerry suggests to Amy that they should head into town for a night out. Alex is puzzled when Kerry asks him to join them, but she claims that a lad and lass can just be friends. Later at the nightclub, Amy has a go at her mum when she sees that Kerry has invited Victoria, Adam and Alex along too, but Kerry is baffled over what the problem is.

Eric wants Kerry out after her antics with Alex last night. He tells her to take responsibility and confess to Amy about what happened. In the café, Amy is shocked and hurt when she discovers that Alex got off with her mum. Kerry tries to explain herself to Amy, who is stunned to hear that Val and Eric have thrown her out.

It's the day of Sarah's operation. At the Dingles', Cameron arrives and asks Lisa to give Sarah a cuddly toy he has brought. However, Lisa refuses to do him any favours and throws it on the bonfire when he's gone.

At the hospital, Debbie is desperate for answers from the doctor about Sarah, but all he can tell her is that she hasn't rejected the transplant. Charity enters and Debbie is unreadable, but she soon sees how hard things are for her mum and admits to her that she is scared about Sarah. Charity pulls her into a hug.

Charity tells Cain that Debbie has no chance of happiness until Cameron is out of her life. Later that morning, Charity panics when Debbie disappears and Cain goes to find her. A distraught Debbie visits Zak who comforts her.

Zak asks Cain if the bruises on Cameron's face are his handiwork, and Cain confirms they are. However, he realises it is the last thing Debbie needs and she has to come first. Soon afterwards, Cameron winds Cain up when he asks him to take a colouring book into hospital for Sarah. Cain is ready to explode, but Zak gets in the way, saying he's not worth it.

Bernice makes a shock reappearance in the village. Outside The Woolpack, she composes herself before walking in through the back door. Diane is stunned to see her daughter, who promptly breaks down in tears. Diane is sympathetic as a teary Bernice tells her how her marriage is crumbling.
At The Woolpack, Bernice is quick to slam down the phone when Ashley appears, and she is sheepish when he comments that he knows she is not back in the village because of her maternal instincts.

Katie turns down Declan's plan to have the day off, wanting things to get back to normal. She then visits Gennie wanting to make up, but Gennie is not in the mood. Soon afterwards, Nikhil is concerned about Declan's mood as he wants him to play pinball and have a drink with him, needing a break now the hard work is out of the way.

At the mineshaft, Declan tries to get to Katie, but the ground starts to crumble away. He tries to reach her by taking his shirt off and throwing it to her, but she loses her grip and falls backwards deeper down into the hole. Declan screams out to her and we see her face is bruised and partially buried.

Declan runs into a field where Moira is and asks her to call the emergency services. He wants her and Andy to come with the tractor to try to get Katie out, but Moira is not convinced it's a good idea.

The emergency services are working on sending a rescuer down the mineshaft. Deep in the mine, Katie drifts in and out of sleep as she lies in pain, unable to fight the exhaustion. A rescue worker is lowered into the hole to locate Katie as Declan looks on nervously, supported by Moira. However, when the rescue worker emerges, it's to report that there is no sign of Katie.
At the mineshaft, Declan is frustrated that the rescue workers don't seem to be doing much, but he is told they have to go slowly to avoid more casualties.

Declan leaves Katie a voicemail, fighting to stay strong for her. Megan is hopeful they'll find her, but Declan fears the worst. In the mine, Katie finally stirs but she is too weak to call out. She tries to drag herself forward as she sees a patch of morning light.

Declan is still fearing for Katie following the accident. Nikhil can see how messed up Declan is as he blames himself for everything that has happened. Declan closes himself off again, telling Nikhil to just go.

Declan is terrified for Katie's life as the nurses try to bring her back. Meanwhile, Moira is getting ready to go to the pub to meet Cain, and she covers when Adam wants to go with her. She is relieved to get away with it and heads out.

Katie is not in a good way, and Declan continues to worry for her but is grateful for Megan's support. At the same time, Gennie is guilty about having fallen out with Katie. Meanwhile, Debbie gives Cain a birthday card, guilty over not buying him a present. Cain nearly calls Moira, but his doubts get in the way.

Rhona is annoyed as Paddy leaves to spend the day with Marlon. On their activity day, Paddy and Marlon are sweating and exhausted during boot camp and sneak off to the bar instead. Spotting an offer for the men's spa, they decide to stay overnight and lie to Rhona and Laurel that they've injured themselves and can't come home.

Rhona promises Brett that she won't tell Paddy about him trying to kiss her, but he should stay somewhere else. Soon afterwards, Rhona calls Paddy but he doesn't answer. When Paddy and Marlon later text to say they're not coming back just yet, Rhona is determined to find out what is going on.

In prison, Chas's solicitor tries to help her, but is impatient with her defeatist attitude. He starts to go over her statement, but Chas has given up and wants him to leave. Once he has gone, Chas looks at the poster on the wall about Tracey's death and goes to her cell, curling up on her bed.

Jimmy is astonished as Cameron furiously explains that Chas has sacked her brief. Gennie is adamant that Cameron has to make Chas see sense because he got her into this mess. Later, Cameron sits outside the police station. He calls his kids, tearful before bracing himself to go inside - preparing to give the detective information about Carl's murder.

Jimmy visits a nervous Chas and the pair are brought together as she apologises. However, Jimmy is determined not to let Carl drag her down. He begs her not to plead guilty, explaining that Carl had it coming and she shouldn't have to pay. At the same time, over at the police station, the detective is frustrated as Cameron insists that he has new information about Carl's murder.
Declan is shocked when Megan tells him that she is moving back to London. He begs her to stay permanently and is thrown when she refuses his offer.

Declan brings a weak Katie home from hospital for a few hours, promising that he will do whatever it takes to make things right between them. Katie is thrown but reluctantly agrees when Declan breaks it to her that he has asked Megan to stay so he can ease up on his workload, but it means Robbie is coming back too.

Edna feels guilty as her credit card arrives. She then agrees to volunteer for the church homeless campaign, but feels awkward when Jude and Ashley put notes into the pot of money and she only offers small change. Later at the vets, Edna is mortified when she tries to pay using her credit card but there's a problem, though it's only because she hasn't activated it.

Priya has been helping out David in the shop, but tells him that it's not going to work. David is concerned further when Priya later tells him that they need to talk. He is speechless when he realises that she's dumping him as she can't bear to break up a family.

Rachel offers to help with the nativity at the church and is keen for Amelia to get the part of Mary. There is tension between Charity and Rachel as the children start to sing carols and they start a slanging match. Jai steps in to mediate, but everyone is stunned when Rachel suddenly holds her stomach in pain, terrified.

Jai is full of worry and asks Sam to keep him updated with any news of the baby. At the same time, Rachel is desperate to know what's going on with her son. Ruby tries to reassure her, but they both know she can't be sure of what will happen.

Charity is angry and lays into Jai about his recent attitude towards her. Jai promises to make it up to her, and Rishi hopes that he has seen sense. Worried that Jai's behaviour will give the game away, Rishi pays a visit to Rachel, hoping that she can talk some sense into Jai and stop him ruining what he already has with Charity and Noah.

Jai explains to Rishi that he is terrified Archie could die without him ever having seen him. At the same time, Rachel struggles to keep strong as Archie is still in the incubator and she is restricted to limited contact. Ruby suggests that Rachel could take a break for a few hours, but Rachel doesn't want to leave him.
The tension in the village is palpable as Charity is about to leave for Chas's trial. Debbie isn't due to give evidence until tomorrow, but she wonders if she should go today.

Charity and Cain are worried about Debbie, who is aggressive as she sets off for court. In the café, Cameron looks like a nervous wreck, totally on edge as he asks Alex to go to court for him and report back on what happens.

Cameron hasn't slept and is a wreck. He snaps at Alex as he is paranoid about giving his evidence and is trying not to freak out. At the same time, over at Mill Cottage, Jimmy is torn between doing the right thing for Chas or his family, as Nicola tells him that he needs to lie in court or he could end up getting sent down himself.

Cameron freezes in court, knowing it's now or never. However, he can't bring himself to confess and instead mouths "I'm sorry" to Chas. The prosecution and defence sum up to the jury and Cameron is convinced that he has sealed Chas's fate, terrified he hasn't done enough.

A paranoid Cameron lurks in the village, regretting his confession. He grabs his confidant as they leave their house, panicked they will go to the police. Cameron says that he'll confess to the authorities himself, but knowing his secret is not safe, he decides to take action. Cameron hits his confidant with a fence post and watches as they slump to the ground unconscious.

Cameron's hostage lies in the van, bound and gagged while Cameron visits Chas. The terrified villager spots a rusty piece of metal and tries to break free from the ropes, but Cameron arrives back. Convincing Cameron to untie the ropes, the villager spots a chance and makes a run for it.
A startled Cameron wakes up in the B&B and remembers that he is living a nightmare as his victim's body lies in the van on Main Street.

Cameron heads to the woods, where he begins digging a hole. Appalled at himself, he then throws the body in and is relieved when the corpse is finally covered. Back at the B&B, Cameron tries to scrub away his guilt in the shower, before heading to see Chas.

Debbie is upbeat as she heads out on a shopping trip with Charity. However, as they drive through the village, Debbie freaks out when she clocks Cameron and decides to drive at him. The car narrowly misses Cameron, and as a huge argument erupts, Debbie blurts out that she still wants Cameron. Back home at Tug Ghyll, Debbie is disgusted with herself and trashes the place in frustration.

Cain is dismayed when he discovers that Debbie nearly ran Cameron over and admitted that she still wants to be with him. At the same time, Cameron claims that his van has been stolen and panics when he is forced to relay his lie to the police that Cain and Debbie might be behind it. Later, the police visit Tug Ghyll to question Debbie and Cain.

Declan panics about Katie as he watches the medical team treat her. He is concerned further when the doctor explains that Katie has got some sort of infection and needs a scan. Soon afterwards, it emerges that Katie has an abscess on her ovary and she needs surgery today.

Katie tells Gennie that she has been given the all clear, as Declan wonders how he's going to burst her bubble. Over at Home Farm, Robbie thinks the news about Katie gives him and Megan the opportunity they need, but Megan wonders where her loyalties lie.

As Moira prepares for her date, Adam is pleased that she is meeting Dom rather than Cain. However, in the café when Dom is distracted, Cain picks up his love rival's motorbike keys and leaves. On hearing his bike engine start up, Dom rushes to the door and can only stare in horror as Cain rides off at speed.

Declan is itching to get back to work and Katie encourages him. However, Megan fears that Declan has got his priorities wrong and struggles to convince him to spend time with Katie. Robbie wants to know what Megan is going to do about getting the money back from Declan, but she is unsure whether she should be playing those kinds of games with her brother.

Charity knows something is up with Jai as he cancels a lunch date and is increasingly more distracted. Rishi fears that Jai is not doing a good job of hiding his worries. At the same time, over at the hospital, Rachel is terrified for Archie when the doctor tells her that the newborn has developed an infection but adds that they've caught it early.

Cameron is floored when a relative of Alex arrives in the village looking for them. The family member vows not to rest until they discover what really happened. Meanwhile, Jai feels the pressure when Charity sees that his phone is ringing and answers it. I

Jai demands to know more about Rishi's visit, but Rachel slams the door in his face and tells him to stay away. He then struggles to contain his anger at the factory as everything winds him up. Soon afterwards, Jai lays into his dad about going to see Rachel, and Charity walks in to find him with Rishi pinned against the wall.

Charity begins asking questions, determined to find out what Jai is holding back. She quizzes Gennie about whether she thinks Jai has been acting strangely. When Rishi is asked, he assures Charity that it's the baby issue, but Charity determinedly follows up her enquiries by asking Dan and Ali.

Jai returns to work and makes an uneasy truce with Nikhil, but soon finds himself clashing with Dan, who takes a stand and walks out. Nikhil is fuming and as he points out all the mistakes that Jai has made, Jai storms out furious. In the café, Rachel is concerned as she sees things aren't good between Jai and Charity.

Noah sulks over wanting to see Jai, leaving Charity torn over what to do. Soon afterwards, Rishi tries to talk to Charity, who is losing patience with Jai. Rishi encourages her to give Jai another chance, but she's at the end of her tether and thinks she should just give up like Jai has.

At Holdgate Farm, Rishi is shocked to hear that Charity has left Jai and insists that he can't let her go without a fight. Over at Pear Tree Cottage, Charity is wound up when she discovers that Jimmy has asked Chas to the family meal, and she tries to hide her frustration when Jimmy says that she has a cold heart.

Chas is unnerved when Jimmy calls her to the graveyard to see that all of the flowers from the other graves have been piled on top of Carl's grave. Chas is unaware that she's being watched. Back at the pub, Chas is terrified when she opens her mail to find a photo of herself with her eyes scratched out and blames a baffled Bernice.

As a shaken Chas sits alone, her mobile rings and she kills the call. At the same time, Nicola is sceptical over Chas's story of having a mystery stalker and tells Jimmy not to make it his fight. Later, Bernice is telling Chas to sort this out when they hear Gabby screaming and hurry through to the back.

There is still tension between Declan and Katie as she declines his offer of going out for the day. Declan smarts and Robbie enjoys the animosity. Soon afterwards, Megan covers as she looks at figures on Declan's computer. She is irked when Robbie questions if she's having second thoughts and his paranoia is still apparent.

Robbie tells Megan that he saw Katie and Andy together and suspects something is going on between them. Megan asks Robbie not to tell Declan. However, Declan is shocked when Robbie lands Katie in it by telling him that she was with Andy rather than Chas yesterday.

Declan tries to make it up to Katie with a slap-up breakfast, and Katie can't help but smile when he vows to make her happy no matter what. At the same time, Megan is uncomfortable when Robbie finds out that the hotel deal has been signed off.

Alicia and David prepare to tell people they're not together anymore. However, David is put out when Alicia milks it for sympathy. As word spreads, David realises that it's not quite going according to plan. David wants Priya to keep things quiet about them for a couple more weeks because of Jacob, but Jacob later spots them kissing and runs off crying.

David is gutted that Jacob is ignoring him. He doesn't see why Alicia and Jacob need to move out, but Alicia is adamant. David is further frustrated when Priya explains that it's making her feel like she's the one in the wrong. Priya insists that she is with David because she cares, not to get one over on Alicia.

Charity thinks Debbie's plan to manipulate Dom is risky. She agrees to get involved, but insists that they need to get Cain on board. Cain believes Debbie is way out of her league with her plan, but she insists that she's going ahead with or without his help.

Cain is worried as the gravity of what they're about to do dawns on him and Charity, but she tells him they'll just have to make sure they don't mess up. Soon afterwards, parked up outside the courier's office, they get the signal to proceed with the plan and Charity makes a phone call as they sit and wait to see the action unfold.

It's early morning, and Debbie pockets Dom's keys before he comes downstairs. Cain is not impressed that Dom has stayed, and Debbie feels disgusted at what she's done. She confides in Charity about her plan to get into Dom's office and take the client list. Charity thinks it's too risky as the police will be sniffing around, but volunteers to go herself.

Cain warns Debbie how serious things are, explaining that she could end up inside. He is furious at what his daughter has become and is unimpressed that she seems determined to sort the mess out herself. Debbie then visits Lisa, wanting her to speak to Dom on her behalf. She hopes Lisa will ask Dom to back off, believing that she owes her one after everything with Chas.

Ali probes Rachel about Sam staying over, but she insists he is just a mate. Jai is close to boiling point over the situation and tells Rishi that Archie is going to grow up thinking Sam is his dad. Later, Jai approaches Rachel and asks her about her relationship with Sam.

Jai panics when Rachel asks what he has to say. He apologises before walking out of the pub. Soon afterwards, Charity is angry with Jai for the scene he has just caused. She makes it clear that it's not okay for him to keep behaving this way.

Priya is torn over what to do about the job, feeling guilty about Alicia. She feels wretched as Alicia ups her game to Nicola, asking when she'll find out about the job. Priya decides that she can't take the job and is saddened as she tells Megan that she can't because of family commitments, adding that Alicia would be perfect for it. Alicia is then delighted when Megan offers her the job.

Alicia is nervous as it's her first day working at Home Farm, but she is glad to have Megan on side with sarcastic Nicola around. At the same time, David is worried about telling Alicia about his engagement, but Priya is excited, explaining that her dad will pay for their wedding.

Debbie sees Belle putting on make-up at the bus stop and is concerned about her relationship with Luke. Soon afterwards, Belle is embarrassed as a suggestive Luke pushes to be alone with her. She agrees they can go back to hers and they leave.

Bernice is blunt as she tells Chas that it's time to get the message - Cameron is not coming back. Fully aware this could be the truth, Chas prepares herself to face the future alone. Soon afterwards, Chas is distraught to hear that none of the family will attend Molly's christening because of her.

Chas decides that she has to sort things with Thomas, thinking it was him who threw the stone. However, Steve suggests that he should have a word, as Thomas won't give him any lip. Steve confronts Thomas, but Sean soon owns up when he sees that Steve is about to call the police. Chas is shocked to learn that it was Sean who smashed the window, not Thomas.

Cameron insists to Chas that he just needed to spend time with his kids and he would never lie to her. She pleads with him to take her away, but he explains that she can't leave just because of a bunch of hypocrites. However, a desperate Chas is at the end of her tether. Downing a double vodka, she tells Bernice that she has won and is welcome to the pub.

Chas explains to Cameron that his rash proposal won't make things right, pointing out that she hadn't even thought he was coming back. However, after some deliberation, Chas agrees to marry him and Cain drives past just as they are kissing. Soon afterwards, Moira puts her foot in it and tells Cain about Chas and Cameron's engagement.

Debbie is still angry with Cain for beating up Cameron, while Zak warns Cain that he won't stand by and watch Debbie get hurt. Zak pleads with Moira to help him get through to Cain, finally making the heartbreaking admission to her that it was him who attacked Cain last winter. Moira is shocked and confronts Cain over it.

Katie is still conflicted over what to do about the christening, but is touched when Declan shows her the gift he has got for Molly. Soon afterwards in the café, Andy is worried for Katie, and Declan is angry that she has been talking to him.

Debbie is due to meet a client, but she is on edge. Cain makes a dig at her, but Debbie is sure her plan will work. Soon afterwards, Charity and Debbie meet Pete in the café. Charity takes a call, leaving Debbie alone with Pete. Debbie is slightly excited at the prospect when Pete asks how she would feel about some extra private work involving drugs.

Outside the village hall, Debbie discreetly tells Pete that she needs to make at least £20,000 in a month. Pete spots Gemma and recognises her as Dom's daughter, and it's clear that Gemma is very wary of him. Gemma and Thomas then warn Dom about seeing Pete. Concerned, Dom calls Charity to meet him at the garage.

Debbie tells Charity and Cain that they've made things worse. She is then shocked and angry when Sarah gets flowers delivered by courier from Pete. Debbie leaves him a harsh message telling him to meet her, before heading to sort things with Pete once and for all. Soon afterwards in The Woolpack, Cain is riled to hear about the flowers and that Debbie has gone to meet Pete.

Declan can't get hold of Katie and is unsure of where she is. Soon afterwards, Andy visits Declan to collect some of Katie's things as she is staying with him. In the shop, Kerry complains to Megan about how much attention Katie is getting from Andy, gossiping about how close they are.

Gabby secretly sneaks half a bottle of vodka from the pub on the way to school.
